content.short: Corporate cards, banking, AP and treasury management.
content.description: Rho is a US business finance platform that combines banking, corporate cards, and spend management for startups and scale-ups. It offers business checking accounts, treasury products that put idle cash into money-market funds and Treasuries, corporate cards with no personal guarantee, accounts payable and bill pay, expense management, and integrations with accounting systems. Rho targets founders and finance teams that want to run banking, payments, and cash management from one integrated platform rather than stitching together separate tools. By pairing accounts and cards with automated AP and treasury, Rho generates a connected stream of financial data where approvals, categorization, and reconciliation are built into everyday operations, positioning it alongside other modern US business banking and spend-management challengers.
content.meta: Rho offers business banking, corporate cards, AP, and treasury in one platform. Discover Rho and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
